name: 黄金拼图PrettyDays
summary: Shinobu and her class are preparing for a play for their school's cultural festival while Aya feels a little distanced from Shinobu for not having any elementary school memories with her. The story will takes us back to the past where Shinobu, Yoko, and Aya in their third year middle school year are preparing for their highschool entrance exam.
